components.name: Text Link
components.css: .ds-text-link { color: #173ea5; font: 400 13px/1.5 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-text-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #173ea5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.css: .ds-nav-active { color: #171717; font: 700 13px/1.5 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #173ea5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Quiet surface for commands and configuration.
components.html:
uv run qg generate
uv run qg validate
components.css: .ds-code { overflow-x: auto; margin: 0; padding: 19px 21px; border-radius: 3px; color: #171717; background: #f3f3f3; font: 400 13px/1.65 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; } .ds-code:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #173ea5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Documentation Sidebar
components.description: Independent left navigation that does not shift the centered article.
components.html: Start hereInstallationQuickstart
components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: grid; gap: 6px; width: 180px; color: #171717; font: 400 13px/1.5 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; } .ds-sidebar a { color: #173ea5; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sidebar .is-active { color: #171717; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

narrative.overview: Quality Graph uses the directness of a small, carefully typeset technical publication. The interface recedes so identity, explanation, and documentation can be understood without learning a visual language first.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Every text role uses the same monospace stack.

rules.name: The Flat Means Flat Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows to interface elements.

dos: Do begin the landing page with the centered logo lockup.
Do keep the article centered relative to the full viewport.
Do use ordinary text links for navigation.
donts: Don't add cards or promotional sections.
Don't let the sidebar push the article away from center.
